capabilities.name: Customer problem discovery
steps: Identify the affected persona and job-to-be-done
Map the current workflow and top frictions
Define discovery questions and evidence gaps
capabilities.validation: Do not claim prevalence or severity without customer evidence
capabilities.example: Analyze these interview notes from a logistics client and identify the three most important workflow problems.

capabilities.name: Market landscape analysis
steps: Define a precise addressable customer segment
Flag where market estimates lack sources
capabilities.validation: Label invented figures as illustrative and cite every sourced fact
capabilities.example: Size the Indian mid-market opportunity for an API-based expense reconciliation tool.

capabilities.name: Competitive product teardown
steps: Separate marketed claims from tested behaviors
capabilities.validation: Do not infer undocumented features or current prices
capabilities.example: Compare three customer support platforms for a 50-person operations team.

capabilities.name: Account and stakeholder intelligence
steps: Identify the account's objectives and constraints
Mark unanswered questions and access boundaries
capabilities.validation: Avoid speculating about private motives or personal attributes
capabilities.example: Prepare a stakeholder map for a hospital CIO onboarding an analytics platform.

capabilities.name: Evidence triangulation and opportunity mapping
steps: Group signals by customer job and friction
Link each claim to available evidence
Form opportunity statements and next experiments
capabilities.validation: Distinguish sourced facts from interpretations
capabilities.example: Synthesize support tickets and onboarding analytics into an opportunity map.

capabilities.name: Multi-format document ingestion
steps: Preserve source references and version dates
Flag inaccessible scanned or password-protected files
capabilities.validation: Never imply unsupported files were read; verify extraction completeness
capabilities.example: Create a source-indexed digest of these SOP PDFs and a pricing spreadsheet.

capabilities.name: OCR and structured extraction
steps: Check image quality and language support
Use available OCR tools only with permission
Extract target fields and coordinates when supported
Route uncertain fields to manual review
capabilities.validation: Do not silently fabricate fields that OCR missed
capabilities.example: Extract invoice number, supplier, totals and tax from scanned invoices.

capabilities.name: Knowledge graph construction
steps: Attach source evidence to each edge
Identify central nodes and missing relationships
capabilities.validation: Every relationship must have evidence or an uncertainty label
capabilities.example: Build a graph connecting accounts, APIs, feature requests and blocked launches.

capabilities.name: Semantic and context-aware retrieval
steps: Rank passages by relevance and recency
Synthesize with exact citations and unresolved gaps
capabilities.validation: Do not answer as though missing or stale content is current
capabilities.example: Find every decision related to SSO migration and summarize unresolved blockers.

capabilities.name: PRD and specification writing
steps: Specify success metrics and acceptance criteria
List decisions and gaps for review
capabilities.validation: No unverifiable metrics or fake stakeholder approvals
capabilities.example: Write a PRD for reducing duplicate order submissions from partner retries.

capabilities.name: End-to-end journey and workflow mapping
steps: List actions, touchpoints and system transitions
capabilities.validation: Validate journey details against actual customer sessions
capabilities.example: Map a courier's signup-to-first-delivery journey including failure states.

capabilities.name: Outcome-oriented roadmapping
capabilities.validation: Do not present dates or resources as committed without approval
capabilities.example: Create a two-quarter roadmap to improve partner onboarding activation.

capabilities.name: Opportunity sizing and prioritization
steps: Evaluate impact, confidence, effort and risk
Recommend a decision and next validation step
capabilities.validation: Use explicitly labeled assumptions rather than fake numerical certainty
capabilities.example: Rank six operations automation ideas using RICE with missing-data flags.

capabilities.name: Hypothesis and experiment design
steps: Plan exposure logging and sample-size review
capabilities.validation: Account for novelty, seasonality and contamination risks
capabilities.example: Design an A/B test for a new self-serve API-key onboarding flow.

capabilities.name: API design and integration planning
steps: Specify auth, retries, rate limits and idempotency
capabilities.validation: No production credentials in outputs; confirm contracts with system owners
capabilities.example: Plan integrating a partner order API with a dispatch service.

capabilities.name: Rapid application prototyping
steps: Generate runnable scaffolding when coding tools are available
Implement representative happy and error paths
Explain setup, test and missing integrations
capabilities.validation: Do not call mock data a production backend
capabilities.example: Create a minimal dashboard for viewing delivery exceptions by partner.

capabilities.name: Codebase navigation and explanation
steps: Identify entry points and request paths
Cite file paths and exact symbols
capabilities.validation: Do not invent files or functions absent from supplied code
capabilities.example: Explain how authentication flows from the web route to the database layer.

capabilities.name: System architecture and data-flow mapping
capabilities.validation: Distinguish proposed architecture from a verified deployed system
capabilities.example: Design a multi-tenant event ingestion system with replay safety.

capabilities.name: Debugging, testing and QA
capabilities.validation: Do not claim a fix is tested without running tests
capabilities.example: Diagnose why an idempotent webhook is still creating duplicate records.

capabilities.name: Deployment and release readiness
steps: Verify QA, performance and security gates
capabilities.validation: Never claim a deployment happened unless deployment logs confirm it
capabilities.example: Prepare release gates for a payment-adjacent partner API migration.

capabilities.name: Wireframing and UX exploration
steps: Select assumptions to validate in usability tests
capabilities.validation: Clearly mark conceptual wireframes versus tested designs
capabilities.example: Explore a better experience for configuring integration error alerts.

capabilities.name: Interactive prototype construction
capabilities.outcome: Build a clickable proof of concept
steps: Create simple navigable screens using supported tools
capabilities.validation: Never claim clicks work when only static mockups were produced
capabilities.example: Build a clickable onboarding wizard for a partner API integration.

capabilities.name: Architecture and sequence diagrams
steps: Pick diagram style appropriate to question
Draw happy path and exception path
capabilities.validation: Do not invent system relationships as implemented facts
capabilities.example: Draw a sequence diagram for customer OAuth consent and token refresh.

capabilities.name: Technical illustrations and CAD assets
steps: Generate geometry with an available CAD or illustration tool
capabilities.validation: Tool-produced geometry is required before claiming CAD output
capabilities.example: Visualize the exploded components of a warehouse conveyor sensor mount.

capabilities.name: Multi-agent task decomposition
capabilities.outcome: Break complex work into agent tasks
steps: Assign clear contracts to specialist agents
capabilities.validation: Do not delegate access beyond the operator's permissions
capabilities.example: Plan research, design and prototype tasks across three specialist agents.

capabilities.name: Task and routine orchestration
steps: Add human approvals for external writes
Record run history and disable controls
capabilities.validation: Do not claim a routine is scheduled unless a scheduler was configured
capabilities.example: Specify a daily blocker digest from project updates without sending messages.

capabilities.name: Browser and API task automation
steps: Model browser steps and failure recovery
Add preview, approval and audit for writes
capabilities.validation: No bypass of MFA, CAPTCHA or access controls
capabilities.example: Automate exporting approved support tickets to a local CSV.

capabilities.name: Composable tool and workflow chains
capabilities.validation: Explicitly flag unimplemented connectors or steps
capabilities.example: Combine discovery notes, API planning and release checks into one implementation brief.

capabilities.name: Permission-scoped execution and controls
capabilities.validation: Never treat an instruction prompt as a security sandbox
capabilities.example: Define a permissions model for an agent reading tickets and drafting replies.

capabilities.name: SQL and structured-data analysis
steps: Run queries when SQL tools are available
capabilities.validation: Never invent query results without executing against data
capabilities.example: Analyze partner onboarding times segmented by integration type.

capabilities.name: Dashboards and visual reporting
capabilities.validation: No made-up live dashboard data or screenshots
capabilities.example: Design a weekly onboarding dashboard for the customer success team.

capabilities.name: Funnel, retention and operational diagnostics
capabilities.validation: State sampling, attribution and metric limitations
capabilities.example: Identify where users abandon a 4-step integration wizard.

capabilities.name: LLM and agent evaluation
capabilities.validation: Never claim benchmark scores without running evaluations
capabilities.example: Create an eval suite for an agent generating SQL queries from natural language.

capabilities.name: Forecasting and scenario modeling
capabilities.validation: Clearly label projections as scenarios, not forecasts guaranteed to occur
capabilities.example: Model expected onboarding revenue at three adoption rates.

capabilities.name: Billing and invoicing workflows
steps: Map billable events and invoice states
capabilities.validation: Do not send invoices or charge accounts without explicit authorization
capabilities.example: Design invoicing for usage-based API requests across two tiers.

capabilities.name: Unit economics and financial modeling
steps: Choose meaningful cost and revenue units
Calculate contribution margin when data supplied
Distinguish CAC, retention and gross margin
capabilities.validation: Explain missing inputs before presenting profitability claims
capabilities.example: Compare enterprise and SMB margins for a workflow automation SaaS.

capabilities.name: Operational command-center design
capabilities.validation: No live operational status without connected evidence
capabilities.example: Design a daily command center for delayed enterprise onboardings.

capabilities.name: Time and resource planning
capabilities.validation: Flag unverified time estimates and staffing commitments
capabilities.example: Plan a two-sprint rollout for three engineers and one designer.

capabilities.name: Speech transcription and meeting notes
steps: Use a speech-to-text engine if available
capabilities.validation: Never present fabricated transcript text or guessed speakers as facts
capabilities.example: Transcribe a recorded customer integration workshop and list commitments.

capabilities.name: Text-to-speech and voice interfaces
steps: Check rights to use voice and content
capabilities.validation: Voice cloning must have appropriate authorization and privacy controls
capabilities.example: Narrate a product onboarding guide in English with a neutral voice.

capabilities.name: Audio separation and editing
capabilities.validation: Do not claim isolated tracks exist without processing the audio
capabilities.example: Separate speech and background music in an authorized webinar recording.

capabilities.name: Video demos and educational content
steps: Capture or generate media with available runtimes
outputs: render files when media tools are available
capabilities.validation: Publishing and external uploads require approval
capabilities.example: Create a 90-second walkthrough for an enterprise integration dashboard.

capabilities.name: SEO and discoverability research
steps: Inspect available pages and technical signals
capabilities.validation: Current ranking or traffic claims need fresh measurements
capabilities.example: Audit discoverability for a B2B developer tooling landing page.

capabilities.name: Launch and channel planning
capabilities.validation: No externally committed dates without owner sign-off
capabilities.example: Plan a regional launch for a healthcare scheduling API.

capabilities.name: Campaigns and content production
steps: Create reusable assets with supported tools
capabilities.validation: Do not publish or impersonate people without authorization
capabilities.example: Draft a launch sequence for a new invoicing feature.

capabilities.name: Conversion and growth experimentation
capabilities.validation: Distinguish correlation from causal lift
capabilities.example: Design a test to raise demo-request conversion while protecting lead quality.

capabilities.name: Career and opportunity research
steps: Review current postings where access exists
capabilities.validation: Never apply or contact recruiters without authorization
capabilities.example: Find senior technical product roles matching API platform leadership.

capabilities.name: Interview preparation and learning plans
steps: Draft STAR stories using real metrics
Build question bank and case prompts
capabilities.validation: Do not invent career achievements or interviewer details
capabilities.example: Prepare for a principal PM interview focused on enterprise integrations.

capabilities.name: Location and map-based research
steps: Retrieve authorized or public location data
capabilities.validation: Do not invent exact coordinates or real-time availability
capabilities.example: Compare three candidate regions for deploying a delivery micro-hub.

capabilities.name: Road and network visualization
capabilities.validation: Network outputs require actual geodata to be called measured
capabilities.example: Study access-road coverage around a proposed distribution center.

capabilities.name: Geospatial data visualization
steps: Represent density, time or categories accurately
capabilities.validation: Never imply simulated map layers are live feeds
capabilities.example: Visualize regional delivery delays using customer-provided coordinates.

capabilities.name: Location-driven field insights
steps: Join spatial observations to operational outcomes
capabilities.validation: Treat location data as sensitive and minimize precise personal tracking
capabilities.example: Prioritize on-site visits using anonymized service issues and travel time.
